definition_zh: 脆的，易碎的；脆弱的，靠不住的；（声音）尖利的
definition_en: hard but liable to break easily; fragile in temper or health; sharp and crackling in sound
core_image: 玻璃般的硬壳，一敲就裂出细纹
scene: 深秋的凉台上，老人捏着一片枯叶轻轻一折。The dry leaf turned brittle and snapped in her fingers.
sceneCN: 这里 brittle 是「脆的、易碎的」（第 1 个义项：硬而无韧，一折即断）；句意是干枯的叶子发脆，在她指间啪地断了。

pos.zh: 脆的；易碎的；脆弱的；（声音）尖利刺耳的

derivatives.zh: 由 brittle 加 -ness 构成，义为「脆性；脆弱」
由 brittle 加 -ly 构成，义为「发脆地；尖利地（罕用）」

senses.title: Hard but easily broken
senses.definition: hard and stiff, but breaking easily under a blow or bend
senses.definitionCN: 硬而僵，但受击或弯折即碎
senses.example: The old paper was so brittle that it cracked at the fold.
senses.why: The core image is a hard shell with no give inside.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是硬壳内里没有韧劲，一折即断。

senses.title: Easily damaged in health or temper
senses.titleCN: 脆弱的；（体质、情绪）易伤的
senses.definition: fragile, as a person's health, nerves or relationships that break under little pressure
senses.definitionCN: 健康、神经或关系稍受压力便崩溃的脆弱状态
senses.example: After the shock, his nerves grew brittle.
senses.exampleCN: 受惊之后，他的神经变得脆弱。
senses.why: What breaks at a touch in objects extends to what collapses at a touch in people.
senses.whyCN: 物一触即碎的属性，转喻为人一触即溃的状态。

senses.title: Sharp and harsh in sound or manner
senses.definition: having a sharp, crackling or coldly hard quality of sound or manner
senses.definitionCN: 声音干裂刺耳，或态度冷硬生涩
senses.example: She gave a brittle laugh and changed the subject.
senses.exampleCN: 她尖利地笑了一声，随即岔开话题。
senses.why: A brittle surface both snaps and rings; the sound sense copies that snap.
senses.whyCN: 脆物既折断又作响，声音义项模仿的就是这声脆响。

intro.en: Brittle probably grew out of an old word for breaking, related to bretan.
intro.cn: brittle 一般认为由古英语表「碎裂」的词派生而来。

items.en: brytan meant to shatter or crush to pieces.
items.cn: 古英语 brytan 意为击碎、碾碎。

items.en: britel meant liable to break, a diminutive of the breaking verb.
items.cn: 中古英语 britel 意为易碎的，由碎裂动词加指小后缀构成。

items.en: spelling settled as brittle; the word spread to temper and sound.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 brittle，词义扩展到性情与声音。

items.en: materials science fixed brittle as the technical opposite of ductile.
items.cn: 材料科学把 brittle 定为 ductile（延展性）的技术反义词。

items.en: brittle covers glass, bones, nerves and laughs.
items.cn: 如今 brittle 可形容玻璃、骨骼、神经与笑声。

note.en: Brittle sits among breaking words and stands against bendable ones.
note.cn: brittle 处于一组碎裂词之间，并与可弯折词相对。

entries.definition: short stiff hairs; to stand up in anger
entries.definitionCN: 刚毛；（毛发）竖起——只是拼写相近，词源不同
脆性，由 brittle 派生的名词

entries.definition: a northern dialect form of brittle

entries.definitionCN: 易碎的；脆弱的，侧重需轻拿轻放
虚弱纤弱的，多形容人或身体

entries.definition: firm and breaking with a clean snap
entries.definitionCN: 酥脆的，常含悦耳爽口之意

entries.definition: able to be stretched without breaking
entries.definitionCN: 有延展性的，brittle 的技术反义词
粉碎；碎裂，brittle 之物的下场

normalIntro.en: Hold brittle against bristle to keep the two straight.
normalIntro.cn: 把 brittle 与 bristle 对照着记，避免混淆。

normal.en: Brittle has TT like a crack splitting the word.
normal.cn: brittle 的双写 tt 像一道裂纹把词劈开。

normal.en: Bristle is hair; brittle is glass.
normal.cn: bristle 是硬毛，brittle 是玻璃。

normal.en: Brittle bones break: the old fear of age.
normal.cn: brittle bones（脆骨）是年老的旧忧。

normal.en: Crisp snaps sweetly; brittle snaps badly.
normal.cn: crisp 脆得悦耳，brittle 脆得糟心。

abstract.en: Hear one dry leaf crack between two fingers.
abstract.cn: 听一片枯叶在指间断裂。

abstract.en: See the hairline zigzag run across old varnish.
abstract.cn: 看见旧漆面上细裂纹蜿蜒而过。

abstract.en: Feel a laugh with nothing warm under it.
abstract.cn: 体会笑声底下毫无暖意的感觉。

examples.en: Handle the brittle old manuscript with cotton gloves.
examples.cn: 戴棉手套翻动发脆的旧手稿。

examples.en: Their truce proved brittle and collapsed within weeks.
examples.cn: 休战证明是脆弱的，几周内便告破裂。

examples.en: He answered in a brittle voice that hid his nerves.
examples.cn: 他以尖硬的声音作答，掩饰着内心的紧张。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「玻璃透」——brittle 像「玻璃」一样硬而「透」脆，一磕就裂。

root: brittle 一般认为源自古英语 brytan（击碎），中古英语 britel 由该动词加指小后缀 -el 构成，义为「易碎的」；更早词根来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: From breaking under the hand, the word moves to breaking under stress, then to a snap in voice and manner.
sensesIntro.cn: 从手感之下的断裂，到压力之下的崩溃，再到声音态度里的干硬脆响。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hard shell cracking at the first blow.
core.cn: 核心意象：硬壳一敲即裂。

intro.en: Brittle is a small family: an abstract noun and a rare adverb.
intro.cn: brittle 词族很小：一个抽象名词，一个罕用副词。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic; its technical opposite is Latin-born ductile.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼语族；其技术反义词 ductile 则出自拉丁语。
